headline: Clinton order puts into effect, for the United States, a 1993 European security group's decision on its legal status and protections.
what_it_does: This order carries out, for the United States, part of a 1993 decision by the Conference on Security and Cooperation in Europe (CSCE). The decision covers the group's legal capacity and its privileges and immunities, such as certain legal protections usually given to international organizations. Only the title is available, so the exact details of which protections apply are not clear.

who_it_affects.group: The Conference on Security and Cooperation in Europe and its officials
who_it_affects.how: The group and its staff may receive the legal status and certain privileges and immunities described in the 1993 decision while in the United States.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 3, 1996; the title does not give a separate start date.
